paragraphs.full_text: “Good morning panel members. Our project, College AI Assistant, solves the problem of scattered college information. It gives students and staff quick answers through a simple AI conversation. We use React, Node.js, MongoDB and an AI API to build the system. Our goal is to make campus information easier to access and offer the solution to colleges through an institution-based model.”
